Death Knight/Lichborn.name: Death Coil
Death Knight/Lichborn.description: A baseline Death Knight ability available independently of the specialization talent tree.

Death Knight/Lichborn.name: Raise Dead
Death Knight/Lichborn.description: Summons an undead servant according to the class rules.

Death Knight/Lichborn.name: Lichborn's Presence
Death Knight/Lichborn.description: A baseline Lichborn ability that is part of the specialization identity rather than a talent node.

Death Knight/Lichborn.name: Consume Fear
Death Knight/Lichborn.description: Minor damage. Generates Runic Power based on the number of targets. Applies Death's Claim.

Death Knight/Lichborn.name: Remorseless Strike
Death Knight/Lichborn.description: Heavy single-target damage with moderate splash damage.

Death Knight/Lichborn.name: Impending Doom
Death Knight/Lichborn.description: Exploits Death's Claim by applying the Impending Doom effect/DoT.

Death Knight/Lichborn.name: Death's Presence
Death Knight/Lichborn.description: Applies the same Impending Doom effect to all targets in range. Higher Runic Power cost than the single-target version.

Death Knight/Lichborn.name: Dominate Mind
Death Knight/Lichborn.description: The target reflects damage it deals back to itself. The threshold/scaling increases with Death's Claim.

Death Knight/Lichborn.name: Betrayal
Death Knight/Lichborn.description: Reduces the target's damage dealt, scaling with Death's Claim. Intended as a defensive/situational ability rather than a core rotational spell.
